intentEvidence: This plugin set tab name to the value for title attribute in the YAML frontmatter for Jekyll users.
problem: Users may want the Obsidian tab name to reflect a short title defined in the note's YAML frontmatter, especially when using Jekyll.

relations.evidence: Many thanks to Tanaka Shumpei and his project Shumpei-Tanaka/obsidian-short-tab-name: a plugin of obsidian for to change showing tab name to short!

summary: A plugin that sets the Obsidian tab name to the value defined in the YAML frontmatter, specifically designed for users utilizing Jekyll.
